4837.title: Source grant acquisition runs behind its own write freeze
4837.rootCauseOneLine: The server-move coordinator freezes writes before source grant acquisition, blocking the account RPC that acquisition may need.
4837.proposedFix: Resolve the source grant before freezing writes; retain cancellation checks and the existing write-freeze policy.
4837.caveats: Coordinator/HTTP-boundary reproduction using actual middleware and migrated SQLite; no live cloud credentials or macOS desktop were used.
